concerns.text: FR-010 mandates a 'dual-annotator' pilot to verify Cohen's Kappa ≥ 0.81 before proceeding. Tasks T011 and T020 only describe a single annotator workflow and a variance check. There is no task to implement the dual-annotator collection, Kappa calculation, or the mandatory halt logic if Kappa < 0.81.

FR-010 requires a Hartigan's Dip Test for bimodality to trigger Fisher's Exact Test. Task T020 only checks for variance thresholds and histograms. No task exists to implement the bimodality detection logic or the conditional branching to Fisher's Exact Test.

FR-004 requires extracting 'temporal pattern features (kurtosis, temporal clustering)' from the divergence trajectory for multivariate regression. Task T017 only calculates the scalar divergence score and writes a CSV. No task is assigned to compute or store these derived features.

FR-006 requires a sensitivity analysis sweeping baseline resolutions N over {500, 200, 100}. Task T023 only sweeps classification thresholds {0.01, 0.05, 0.1} and assumes a single N. No task exists to re-run inference or recalculate metrics across different Euler step counts.

The plan's 'Control Analysis' section mandates a Mann-Whitney U test or t-test to compare divergence scores between continuous/discontinuous groups. Task T022 only handles correlation coefficients. No task is assigned to implement this specific group-comparison logic.

SC-002 requires the full pipeline to complete within 6 hours. Task T016 only implements a pre-flight check to *estimate* runtime. There is no explicit task to enforce the hard 6-hour timeout or log the actual total duration of the full 500-clip run to verify compliance.

Constitution Principle VII requires manual annotations to be recorded in a 'raw, immutable CSV'. Task T011 describes a CLI tool outputting `data/raw/annotations.csv` but lacks explicit instructions for the immutability mechanism (e.g., write-once flags or checksum locking) to prevent post-hoc modification.
